div.head: VIII Atr 39
div.ab: And git mæg ðeah bot cuman, wille hit man georne on eornost aginnan.
And git mæg ðeah bot cuman, wille hit man georne on eornost aginnan.
And git mæg ðeah bot cuman, wille hit man georne on eornost aginnan.
Und doch kann wohl noch Besserung kommen, wolle man es [nur] eifrig im Ernste beginnen.
And yet amendment may still come, if only it is eagerly begun in earnest.
And yet nevertheless improvement can come, if there is the zealous desire to begin it in earnest.
And yet improvement can still come, if one will begin it zealously and in earnest.
And improvement may still come, assuming there is a sincere desire to act upon it in earnest.

note.seg: Gyf we bote gebidan sculan . ., mid swyðe miclan earnungan we þa bote motan æt Gode geræcan, gyf hit sceal godiende wurðan predigt Wulfstan 157. Und Æthelred II. versprach den ihn aufnehmenden Witan: he wolde ælc þæra þinga betan, þe hi ealle ascunedon; Ann. Anglosax. 1014

Gyf we bote gebidan sculan . ., mid swyðe miclan earnungan we þa bote motan æt Gode geræcan, gyf hit sceal godiende wurðan, Wulfstan preaches, 157. And Æthelred II promised the Witan who received him: he wolde ælc þæra þinga betan, þe hi ealle ascunedon; Ann. Anglosax. 1014
